pieces.Text: When manifesting stomp, you can expend a daily use of your stomp psi-like ability to manifest the power augmented to your full manifester level without paying any power point cost, although such a manifestation is not eligible to be affected by metapsionic feats or similar effects that would normally increase the cost of manifesting the power.  Stomp counts as a path power for purposes of the half-giant's alternate favored class bonus.  In addition, when manifesting stomp, you can choose for the power to deal lethal instead of nonlethal damage and gains the additional augment options below.  Augment: If you spend 2 additional power points, allies in the affected area are not subject to the effects of this power.  If you spend 2 additional power points, the area affected becomes a 10 ft. burst centered on you.
